maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.detail: The path slopes toward the southern cemetery, mud slick between the leafless trees.
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.detail-11: A tattered tapestry clings to the rock, rain pressing it flat against the cold stone. The mark of the eye shows faintly through the fabric.
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.detail-13: As you cross beyond the mausoleum's threshold, Ixarion twists in the air above you.
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.detail-4: At the rear of the graveyard, you discover a sunken courtyard overgrown with roots. An old stone mausoleum stands at its center.

maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.detail-9: A ring of half melted candles sits in a quiet corner of the graveyard. At the center, the soil is dark with blood.
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.dialogue: Headstones lean in the damp earth, rusted rails jutting like broken teeth. Mist drifts low among the graves, whispering to a place the city rarely visits.
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.dialogue-: You adjust your robe, eyes scanning the fog.
"Ectoplasmic residue stays stable for days," you remark casually. "Would make a fine base for mana elixirs."
Choose “Souls here aren't resting.”
You kneel, pressing your palm to the cold soil. Beneath, faint echoes. Sorrow, anger, hunger. Not at peace.
"They linger," you whisper. "Bound to pain..."
At the rear of the graveyard, you discover a sunken courtyard overgrown with roots. An old stone mausoleum stands at its center.
Its entrance stands open. There are no guards, no signs of movement. Only the steady sound of rain against the stone steps.
"Quiet. Magic leaves echoes. I'm listening." (Requires Wizard)
"Hold on. Let me check the ground. See who's been walking here." (Requires Ranger)
"Wait. Let me check the entrance." (Requires Thief)
"Souls here aren't resting." (Requires Elk)
"This place was meant for the dead... but something is wrong." (Requires Paladin)
Choose “This place was meant for the dead... but something is wrong.”
You close your eyes for a moment and reach beyond stone, rain, and silence, searching for the presence of evil.
It answers. Deep below the mausoleum, you feel it in overwhelming weight. Not one presence, but many.
The dead do not sleep here.
Yet beneath them, behind them... there is something else. Living.
"There is great evil below," you say quietly. "And not all of it belongs to the dead."
Choose “Quiet. Magic leaves echoes. I'm listening.”
"Residual energy," you whisper. "No traps. No wards. Whatever magic once guarded this place has already gone."
Choose “Hold on. Let me check the ground. See who's been walking here.”
"Hope there are some ghosts ahead..." (Requires Wizard)
You crouch near the steps, brushing away a thin layer of dust. Beneath, faint tracks cross and overlap. Boots, not beasts.
"Too many to count."
Choose “Wait. Let me check the entrance.”
You run your fingers along the stone frame and the worn hinges, searching for hidden wires, needles, or pressure plates.
Nothing. No tricks, no poison, no surprises. Just the dark entrance.
As the final relic touches the stone, the symbols on the monuments begin to glow. A dry, distant voice echoes through the graveyard.
It speaks not to your ears, but to the blood in your veins.
"The blood of He Who Watches still feeds the roots."
Then, silence. The light fades, the wind returns, and you know this was no mere phrase. It was a vow, and a key.
A ring of half melted candles sits in a quiet corner of the graveyard. At the center, the soil is dark with blood.
"This place is tainted. I will cleanse whatever walks here." (Requires Paladin)
Nearby, a tattered cloak flutters in the breeze, caught on a broken gravestone. No sign of who or what performed the ritual.
A tattered tapestry clings to the rock, rain pressing it flat against the cold stone. The mark of the eye shows faintly through the fabric.
Nearby, a bloodmonk lies in the wet brush, face turned to the sky, his throat opened by a single arrow. No struggle. Just one clean shot left to wash in the rain.
Its laughter scrapes across the graves.
"My leash ends here, little mortals."
Choose “This place is tainted. I will cleanse whatever walks here.”
You step forward, gaze sweeping across the crooked graves.
The air is thick with corruption.
"By oath and steel, I will purge this place of evil."
Choose “Hope there are some ghosts ahead...”
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.m01.detai: The tombstone has collapsed into rubble. Whatever was written here is gone for good.
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.m03.detai: Died to a rabbit with a crossbow.
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.m04.detai: He carried the burden for too long. The ring crushed him.
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.m09.detai: Last seen entering the Upside Down.
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.m11.detai: Week of the Plague. Day of his death.
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.m13.detai: What is dead may never die.
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.m14.detai: Slain by his own reflection. Cursed blade in hand.
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.m15.detai: He aimed for the head. He missed.
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.m16.detai: He dreamt of gods. One answered.
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.m18.detai: Only broken stone remains. No name.
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.m19.detai: He only opened a treasure chest.
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.m20.detai: Only in death does duty end.
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.m23.detai: A pact was made. A price was paid.
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.m25.detai: Marked by wyrdness. Claimed by silence.
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.m27.detai: I'm cold and slender, with teeth that bite, But I don't eat - I grant you might.
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.m28.detai: Here lies Reginald. Please return his hat.
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.m29.detai: Burned the book. Still couldn't forget.
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.m32.detai: Bearer of the curse. Finally free.
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.m33.detai: From raven's back or angel's fall - Brush the name, and hear the call.
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.m35.detai: Death was not the worst fate. But it was the last.
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.m36.detai: Lured a dragon with a rock. It worked.
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.m37.detai: Teleported into a wall. Rest in pieces.
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.m38.detai: Here lies a man who trusted Aletheides.
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.m39.detai: Tied to fate. Tangled in fog.
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.m41.detai: A servant in life. A thrall in death.
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.m43.detai: Ash to dust. Dust to the Dustmen.
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.m45.detai: He needed a moonstone. Got a tombstone.
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.m46.detai: Flip me once, and count your sins - The gate will open if fate wins.
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.m48.detai: He said Boo was just a hamster.
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.m51.detai: I am what's left when fire weeps, The final gift the pyre keeps.
maps.points.underkeep_cemetery.m52.detai: Buried in Sigil. Lost everywhere else.
